headline: Two o'clock keeps the lamp.
body: The street has emptied to a single parked car and the sound of its cooling metal. Inside, the page remains open at the sentence that will not finish. Outside, nothing moves except the slow drift of a cloud across the moon.

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: desk lamp only, amber at the edges

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: clear, moon half-hidden by thin cloud
